bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Arbitrum is PGOLD's only native issuance chain. Ethereum and Pharos are Chainlink CCIP burn/mint representations sourced from the Arbitrum LockReleaseTokenPool, while ApeChain is a LayerZero OFT representation backed by the Arbitrum OFT Adapter. The external message-validation, pool, adapter, and representation-admin surfaces support the aggregate external-lock-mint tier.

routes.reviewNote: Native PGOLD on Arbitrum is the sole canonical issuance route. At Arbitrum block 495272772 (2026-08-16), token owner() returned issuer EOA 0x142a96da210dec495a76e56058563549ac12bab4 and its mint simulation succeeded. The separate OFT Adapter 0xbfd47e6098017c04957ba218dade65e23f661793 locks this token for the ApeChain LayerZero representation; its owner is 0x25a6a7fbe039c14b06adb6bda434b960981dbaed.

At ApeChain block 46540614 (2026-08-16), endpoint() returned LayerZero Endpoint V2 0x6f475642a6e85809b1c36fa62763669b1b48dd5b and peers(30110) returned the Arbitrum OFT Adapter 0xbfd47e6098017c04957ba218dade65e23f661793. At block 46540809, a current owner-originated mint simulation reverted. This deployment is therefore the Pleasing Gold OFT representation; its cross-chain mint/burn path is assessed under Bridge Risk rather than native issuance.

At Ethereum block 25770422 (2026-08-16), Chainlink's PGOLD directory and current pool/token reads identify this as the BurnMintTokenPool representation sourced from the Arbitrum LockReleaseTokenPool 0x5b5ce779709360a6b6906b79cac5029a5b7ccdc4. The local pool is 0xf3067615579d59c64f16f1382b6a8032622f810a, its owner and token CCIPAdmin are issuer EOA 0x142a96da210dec495a76e56058563549ac12bab4, and the local CCIP router is 0x80226fc0ee2b096224eeac085bb9a8cba1146f7d. getMinters() returned only the local pool; the pool mint path requires a CCIP message and is not native Ethereum issuance.

routeChecks.caps: At Arbitrum block 500605267 on 2026-09-01, adapter 0xbfd47e6098017c04957ba218dade65e23f661793 exposed no mint ceiling: cap(), maxSupply(), mintCap(), supplyCap(), and mintingLimit() all reverted. approvalRequired() returned true and token() returned canonical PGOLD 0x3e76bb02286bfeaa89dd35f11253f2cbce634f91, confirming a lock/release adapter, and its EIP-1967 implementation slot was zero, so it is not upgradeable. The escrowed balance floats with deposits and withdrawals and is not a contract-enforced cap, so no cap-raising bound applies.
